evidence.criterion: O3: Important cases receive enough repetitions to report per-case pass rates and expose nondeterministic regressions.

human_labels.judge_rationale: The artifact correctly requires a full A/B/C sweep, fresh blind runners, separate evidence-based judges, per-case rates, and regression checks. It falls short by making A/C repetition conditional, omitting diagnosis of skill defects versus bad cases and the iterative diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop, and not requiring a fully legible before/after per-case comparison. Its additional requirement for “a clean-checkout sweep after every run” is materially unnecessary for the stated evaluation task, so it is a cost regression.

observations.value:
Re-evaluate all cases—A, B, and C—not only B—to detect regressions. Use fresh, context-free blind runners for every case and keep each runner unaware of the bar and expected outcome. Grade each artifact separately using a fresh judge given only the artifact, that case’s bar, and the skill’s first principles.

Because agent output is nondeterministic, run each material or borderline case 2–3 times—at minimum B, and A/C where confidence or regression risk warrants it. Before claiming success, report:

- Per-case pass rates after the edit.
- Evidence-grounded verdicts citing specific artifact text or pointers for every part of each bar.
- Confirmation that B’s original gap is resolved.
- Confirmation that A and C still pass and were not regressed.
- A clean-checkout sweep after every run, with any leaks cleaned.

The fix worked only when all cases clear their required rate bars; one successful run of B is insufficient.
